profile.name: Modbus ADU 客户端到服务器报文解析器
profile.description: 这是一个用于解析 Modbus 协议中客户端发往服务器的应用数据单元（ADU）报文的软件协议解析组件，而非特定物理仪器。它可用于实验室或工业现场的串口/总线通信分析，帮助识别读寄存器、写多线圈、写多寄存器、读文件记录等 Modbus 请求帧。
profile.description_en: This is a software protocol parsing component for Modbus client-to-server Application Data Unit (ADU) messages rather than a specific physical instrument. It is used in laboratory or industrial serial/bus communication analysis to identify Modbus request frames such as register reads, multiple coil writes, multiple register writes, and file record reads.

registry.name: Modbus Adu Cs
registry.description: Modbus ADU CS是由Modbus (Open Standard)生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括关闭、写入数据、启动、复位、日志记录、读取数据。
